points.statement: Autonomous embodied verification techniques help agents bridge the gap and support creative tasks.
points.quote: In this work, we introduce autonomous embodied verification techniques for agents to fill the gap, laying the groundwork for creative tasks.

points.statement: A structural speculation stage synthesizes instructions into a program representing building objects through decomposition, subcomponent generation, and assembly.
points.quote: The 3D structural speculation stage uses VLM to synthesize Instructions II into a CAD program representing the building 3D objects, which further includes decomposing, subcomponents generation, and assembling.

points.statement: Visual verification judges building quality using appearance results from constructing a program.
points.quote: The visual verification evaluates the quality of buildings through the appearance results of the CAD program construction.

points.statement: A construction stage converts an object program into executable construction actions to realize the building in the environment.
points.quote: The construction stage uses VLM to synthesize the building’s 3D object program into executable construction actions to get the building in the environment.

points.statement: Pragmatic verification assesses object pragmatism by generating environment-relevant functionality annotations and action verify programs.
points.quote: The pragmatic verification evaluates the building 3D object’s pragmatism by generating environment-relevant functionality annotations and action verify programs.
